project.title: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of anodic biofilm from a constructed wetland microbial fuel cell treating cow dung and fruit peel extract
project.description: A constructed wetland microbial fuel cell (CWMFC) was operated using a substrate made of a mixture of cow dung and fruit peel extract, and the anodic biofilm microbial community was analyzed by metagenomic approach. The dataset consists of 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing to describe the bacterial community involved in bioelectricity production and wastewater treatment.
